title: arrhenatherum bulbosum var. precatorium
intro: Arrhenatherum bulbosum var. precatorium, commonly known as sweet woodruff, is a perennial flowering plant native to Europe, western Asia, and northern Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of sweet woodruff include its use as a calming agent to relieve anxiety and insomnia, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. Bioactive constituents of sweet woodruff include coumarin, a compound responsible for its medicinal properties, which has been found to exhibit antioxidant and antispasmodic activities.
